Manifest.Name: 直接替换 / Quick Replace
Manifest.Author: w7lau
Manifest.Description: 把新滤芯拖到水壶上，或把新电池拖到电器上，直接换下旧的。旧件放回原来的物品栏，放不下就不换。 把电池拖到充电器本体上：有空位就先放入，放不下时才换出剩余电量最多、且电量比拖入电池更高的一块。打开充电器后，可以把电池拖到指定电池上交换，或拖到空格里放入。 Drag a new filter or battery onto a device to replace the old one. The old item returns to the source inventory; nothing is swapped if it cannot fit. Drop a battery onto the charger itself to fill empty space first, or take its highest-energy battery if the charger is full and that battery has more charge. Inside the open charger, drop onto a specific battery to swap with it, or onto empty space to place it there.
